Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and audited financial statements on June 3, 2026, granting full discharge to the Board of Directors and Commissioners. The owner is not stated.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved the allocation of Rp 979.6 billion in net profit, including Rp 184.2 billion for cash dividends at Rp 40 per share. The owner is not stated.
Agenda #3: Shareholders approved a maximum 2026 remuneration of Rp 15 billion for the boards and a maximum 2025 bonus of Rp 6.5 billion for boards and employees. The owner is not stated.
Agenda #4: The Board of Commissioners was authorized to appoint an independent auditor for the 2026 financial year and determine the associated fees. The owner is not stated.
Agenda #5: Shareholders approved delegating authority to the Board of Commissioners to authorize the pledging or transfer of more than 50% of the company's net assets for financing purposes until December 31, 2026. The owner is not stated.
Agenda #6: The meeting approved updating the company's business activities in the Articles of Association to align with the 2025 Indonesian Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI) regulations. The owner is not stated.
Agenda #7: Shareholders ratified the increase in PT Terang Anugrah Abadi's shareholding to 3,269,608,000 shares following transactions conducted through the stock exchange. The owner is not stated.
